title: Windmill with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- windmill tower -->
  <polygon points="38,85 62,85 56,40 44,40" fill="#e8a44a"/>
  <polygon points="38,85 50,85 50,40 44,40" fill="#f0b860"/>
  <!-- tower door -->
  <rect x="45" y="68" width="10" height="17" rx="5" fill="#8a4a1a"/>
  <rect x="45" y="68" width="5" height="17" rx="3" fill="#a85c24"/>
  <!-- windmill cap -->
  <polygon points="40,40 60,40 50,24" fill="#d84a3a"/>
  <polygon points="40,40 50,40 50,24" fill="#ea6250"/>
  <!-- blades -->
  <g transform="translate(50,40)">
    <!-- blade 1 (up-left) -->
    <g transform="rotate(-45)">
      <rect x="-3" y="-32" width="6" height="32" fill="#f5f0e0"/>
      <rect x="-3" y="-32" width="3" height="32" fill="#fffaf0"/>
      <rect x="-1" y="-32" width="2" height="32" fill="#d8d0b8"/>
    </g>
    <!-- blade 2 (up-right) -->
    <g transform="rotate(45)">
      <rect x="-3" y="-32" width="6" height="32" fill="#f5f0e0"/>
      <rect x="-3" y="-32" width="3" height="32" fill="#fffaf0"/>
      <rect x="-1" y="-32" width="2" height="32" fill="#d8d0b8"/>
    </g>
    <!-- blade 3 (down-left) -->
    <g transform="rotate(-135)">
      <rect x="-3" y="-32" width="6" height="32" fill="#f5f0e0"/>
      <rect x="-3" y="-32" width="3" height="32" fill="#fffaf0"/>
      <rect x="-1" y="-32" width="2" height="32" fill="#d8d0b8"/>
    </g>
    <!-- blade 4 (down-right) -->
    <g transform="rotate(135)">
      <rect x="-3" y="-32" width="6" height="32" fill="#f5f0e0"/>
      <rect x="-3" y="-32" width="3" height="32" fill="#fffaf0"/>
      <rect x="-1" y="-32" width="2" height="32" fill="#d8d0b8"/>
    </g>
    <!-- hub -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" fill="#8a4a1a"/>
    <circle cx="-1" cy="-1" r="3" fill="#c87838"/>
  </g>
  <!-- smiling face on tower -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="52" r="2.5" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="52" r="2.5" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <path d="M43 57 Q50 63 57 57" stroke="#1a1a2e" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="39" cy="56" r="2.5" fill="#ea6250" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="56" r="2.5" fill="#ea6250" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
